title: Certifier accreditation and registration
summary: This page provides information about the accreditation and registration requirements for certifiers in NSW.

internal_links.text: Apply for swimming pool certifier registration
Access the NSW Building Certifiers' Portal

faqs.a: A Principal Certifier (PC) is a role that involves specific accreditation and registration.

faqs.q: How do I apply for swimming pool certifier registration?
faqs.a: You can apply for swimming pool certifier registration using the dedicated transaction page.

faqs.q: Where can I access the NSW Building Certifiers' Portal?
faqs.a: You can access the NSW Building Certifiers' Portal via the provided referral link.
